content:
Guru is a smart AI-powered personal tutor designed for interactive learning. To get started, download a course (such as a sample paper) from the Course Store, open any question, and Guru will begin explaining instantly. You can use the microphone to interrupt or ask questions—tap once to speak and tap again to stop.

The app uses a split-screen interface. The top section, called the Reading Pane, displays learning materials like PDFs, videos, and images. The bottom section, called the Whiteboard, allows you to take notes, draw, and interact with Guru. You can resize the whiteboard by dragging up or down and zoom using pinch gestures.

The Input Bar provides multiple ways to interact with Guru, including typing text, speaking via the microphone, attaching images, and using drawing mode to annotate. You can also open the keyboard when needed. The App Menu provides navigation and controls, and you can hide or unhide the Reading Pane as required.

Guru offers real-time explanations, voice interaction with interruption capability, and supports multi-input methods such as text, voice, image, and drawing. It enables a deeply interactive learning experience.

For best results, use the microphone for faster help and use drawing to ask clearer questions.

Key terms: A Course is curated study material like books or sample papers. The Reading Pane is the top section for viewing content. The Whiteboard is the bottom section for notes and interaction. The Input Bar contains tools like mic, image upload, text input, and drawing.

Your data is सुरक्षित and protected using industry standards. Guru does not send your study interactions to the server. If your course is not available, you can request it through the feedback form, and new courses are added regularly. The app is currently free to use during early development.

In summary, Guru is a split-screen AI tutor where you learn from content on the top and interact, ask questions, draw, and explore on the bottom.
